# `kernel/execution/ActiveTurnCoordinator.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/execution/ActiveTurnCoordinator.js`

ActiveTurnCoordinator.js — bounded, provider-neutral user steering for one active AI executor request. It owns ordering and deduplication only; kernel policy, tool approval, persistence, and model dispatch remain elsewhere.

## Functions

### `classifySteeringMessage(value)`

### `classifySteeringImpact(kind, value = '')`

Describe which cached work a steering message invalidates. This is a data decision only; it never widens authority or silently approves a new target.

### `classifySteeringDelivery(kind, value = '', { progressEstimate = null } = {})`

Select when one operator instruction should affect an active task. This is deliberately a score of the instruction/task relationship, never a score of the person. It is deterministic, local, content-free in diagnostics, and grants no authority. The task Storylet consumes the resulting delivery mode at its next transition.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
